M-TOOL-MANAGER.Purpose: Tool discovery and lifecycle: static registry initialized from the [Tool(id)] assembly scan, driven by the FlexTools mod entry with persisted enablement settings.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: ToolManager: static registry, Initialize/Shutdown, per-tool enablement.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: FlexToolsMod: RimWorld Mod entry point. FlexToolsSettings: ModSettings persistence of tool enablement. Tool contract — owned by M-TOOL.

Requirements.REQ-001: Tool enablement state persists across sessions via FlexToolsSettings.
Requirements.REQ-002: Initialize/Shutdown are idempotent per tool: a disabled tool is never initialized.

Inputs.IN-001: mod assembly: scanned for ToolAttribute-decorated Tool types.

Outputs.OUT-001: initialized tool instances available for the lifetime of the session.
